newsitem.title: USA: ESPN to launch new sports magazine.
newsitem.headline: ESPN to launch new sports magazine.

text.p: Television network ESPN Inc is taking its brand of sports journalism to the print world.
ESPN, which is owned by Walt Disney Co and Hearst Corp, plans to debut ESPN Magazine in the first quarter of 1998, the company said.
Michael Rooney, who has been a publisher at Times Mirror Co's magazine division, has been named publisher of the new magazine, which is to be published biweekly.
"All our research indicates that both sports fans and advertisers are receptive to an ESPN magazine," ESPN Magazine Senior Vice President and General Manager John Skipper said in a statement.

John Walsh, ESPN senior vice president and executive editor who is to help fashion and guide the editorial direction of the new publication, said the magazine will have the same feel as ESPN's television programming.
"It's developed a unique voice," Walsh told Reuters. "We try to look at sports through a passionate prism."
ESPN is 80 percent owned by Disney and 20 percent owned by Hearst. ESPN reaches 212 million homes around the world; its four-year-old ESPN2 network reaches 46 million homes in the United States.
